dog.description_text:
Say hello to Jacob, a sweet and handsome chihuahua mix who is ready to find his forever home! He is in that sweet spot of puppyhood, bringing a mix of gentle curiosity and big potential. Jacob is incredibly sweet, loves to be close to his people, and will gladly roll over for belly rubs any chance he gets. Whether he is rolling himself into a tight little donut right beside you on the couch or hanging out in his crate, he is happiest soaking up your company.

The ideal match for him is a patient adopter ready to guide him with gentle love and encouragement as he discovers everything for the first time. If you are ready to share your home, lap, and heart with a sweet little dog who will reward you with a lifetime of devotion, Jacob is ready to trot straight into your life!

Registered adopters interested in Jacob can email adopt@hbrdogs.com for more info. If you’re not registered yet, do it today at hbrdogs.com!
